title: Idiomi i izrazi
grammarTip: Idiomi su ustaljeni izrazi čije se značenje ne može izvesti iz pojedinačnih riječi — 'praviti se Englez' nema nikakve veze s Engleskom, već znači 'pretvarati se da neko ne razumije'. Idiomi obično ne mijenjaju svoju strukturu (ne kaže se 'praviti se Francuz' s istim značenjem), a njihovo poznavanje i pravilna upotreba znak su gotovo izvornog vladanja jezikom.

vocab.en: to be completely out of touch (lit. 'to fall from Mars')
to be overjoyed (lit. 'to be in the seventh heaven')
to feign ignorance (lit. 'to act like an Englishman')
to deceive/lead someone on (lit. 'to pull someone by the nose')
never (lit. 'when grapes grow on a willow')
to have butterflies in one's stomach
to hold one's tongue / keep quiet
to work very hard (lit. 'to work like a horse')
to make a mountain out of a molehill (lit. 'to make an elephant out of a fly')
to be on the same wavelength
to turn a blind eye (lit. 'to look through one's fingers')

exercises.prompt: Šta znači izraz 'biti u sedmom nebu'?
exercises.promptEn: What does the expression 'biti u sedmom nebu' mean?

exercises.prompt: Kojim izrazom kažemo da se neko 'pretvara da ne razumije'?
exercises.promptEn: Which expression means someone 'is pretending not to understand'?

exercises.prompt: Sastavi izraz koji znači 'nikad' (kad se to nikad neće desiti).
exercises.promptEn: Build the expression meaning 'never' (something that will never happen).
Match the idioms with their meaning.

pairs.en: to make a mountain out of a molehill
to be on the same wavelength

exercises.promptEn: Listen and choose the correct translation.
exercises.answer: He always works very hard to support his family.
choices: He always works very hard to support his family.
He never listens to his family.
He always argues with his family.
exercises.targetPhrase: Uvijek radi kao konj da bi izdržavao porodicu.
Nemoj me vući za nos, reci mi istinu.
